units.function: Optional live SSH smoke-test harness that discovers explicit or fixture credentials, initializes a remote workspace and verifies basic git, tar and pwd command availability.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> adapter-utils SSH/env-lab helpers -> local environment/files and optional fixture process/container -> real SSH server; it bypasses Company identity, SecretPort, Connector policy, database and audit/evidence services.
units.keyDataModels: SSH host/port/user/workspace/private key/known_hosts/strict-check config, env-lab state path and command result with bounded timeout/buffer.
units.lifecycle: Read optional credentials -> reuse or start fixture -> ensure remote workspace -> execute a tool-discovery command -> assert basic output -> stop only a fixture started by this test.
units.testAssessment: The deliberate no-fixture focused run skipped 1/1. No live connection was executed. More importantly, default fixture-resolution failure returns successfully inside the test rather than skip/fail, allowing a false-green smoke test. Coverage is only basic connectivity/tool presence and omits trust failure, credential lifecycle, cancellation, recovery, permissions, containment and audit.
units.designRationale: Make a real SSH check convenient for developers with either preconfigured infrastructure or a disposable local lab while avoiding a mandatory external dependency in ordinary test runs.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS requires trustworthy qualification and ongoing health checks for customer-local execution nodes without real credentials in fixtures or ambiguous test outcomes.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT as a gated Connector conformance suite with explicit PASS/SKIP/INFRA_ERROR outcomes, capability and platform metadata, hermetic disposable credentials, strict pinned-host negative tests, argument-safe command execution, cancellation/recovery checks and secret-free signed evidence. Keep local fixture convenience separate from CI acceptance.
units.responsibilityConflict: The test proves neither an accountable operator nor an approved execution-node enrollment, and emits no attestation tying the checked host, credential audience, binary versions or workspace policy to a Company OS responsibility contract.
evidence: 2026-08-19 focused Vitest with PAPERCLIP_ENV_LIVE_SSH_NO_AUTO_FIXTURE=true: 1/1 skipped; no live SSH claim
units.securityFindings: HIGH false-assurance gap: default fixture/config resolution failure returns a passing test without a connection. HIGH command-construction gap: JSON double quoting does not safely escape arbitrary values for POSIX shells. HIGH credential/trust gap: raw inline/file credentials and strict-check override lack negative tests, permission checks and zeroization. MEDIUM conformance gap: no explicit outcome schema, enrollment identity, attestation, cancellation/recovery or data-policy validation.
